description: Starts a sign-up to QDev's email list for a person who asked to join. QDev emails that address a confirmation link, and the address joins the list only when its owner opens the email and presses Confirm. Before calling, show the person this text and get their yes: "One email when each product opens and when an event is announced, and nothing else. Every one has a one-click unsubscribe link. Sent by QDev Inc., 675 Sturdivant Drive, Clarksville, TN 37042, info@quantumdev.io. Privacy Policy: https://quantumdev.io/privacy/#email-list"

agreed.description: True only when the person has been shown the text in this tool's description and has said yes to it.

name: join_email_list
title: Join the QDev email list
